rust_summary: a server player's client sent a custom click action (`native_custom_click_action`).
doc_summary: `native_custom_click_action(player, name, id, payload)`, when a server player's client sends `ServerboundCustomClickActionPacket` in play: the `custom` click event of a dialog button or a text component. `id` is the resource location text, `payload` the optional tag as SNBT text (`None` when the client sent none). Vanilla only logs the packet. Listen-only. Server-side. Bundles need "hooks": @API:custom_click_action@.
